purpose: Canonical private mapping for blog, OpenList, and real netdisk storage. This file exists to prevent confusing a server directory with an OpenList-mounted netdisk again.

blog.note: /srv/myblog/public-data is a server/blog data directory. It may be useful for static blog assets, but it is not the OpenList-mounted netdisk.

openlist_storage_mounts.write_policy: Use OpenList API. Do not write to a local host directory and call it netdisk.

mortis_ai_society_export.verified_probe_result: OpenList API mkdir, put, and list returned code=200 success.
mortis_ai_society_export.local_cache_note: This cache is allowed for diagnostics/retry only. The durable user-facing destination is the real OpenList remote dir above.

MORTIS_OPENLIST_TOKEN.source: sudo docker exec openlist sh -lc './openlist admin token --data /opt/openlist/data 2>/dev/null'

openlist_api_examples.get_admin_token: sudo docker exec openlist sh -lc './openlist admin token --data /opt/openlist/data 2>/dev/null'
openlist_api_examples.upload_file: curl -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:5244/openlist/api/fs/put -H 'Authorization: <token>' -H 'File-Path: /夸克网盘/Mortis-AI-Society/example.json' -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --data-binary @example.json

anti_mistake_rules: If the user says OpenList netdisk, write through OpenList API to an OpenList storage mount path such as /夸克网盘/..., not to /srv/myblog/public-data.
If a path starts with /srv/myblog or /srv/multica, treat it as a server path/cache unless OpenList storage explicitly maps it.
Verify OpenList storage mounts from /srv/openlist/data/data.db table x_storages before choosing a remote destination.
Verify successful netdisk writes by listing the remote path with /openlist/api/fs/list.
Never print the OpenList token in normal reports.
